predictions_frozen_before_training.D1: tinydec vs baseline: native PSNR loss <=0.05 dB at x4 and x6, and its R(u) differs by <=0.01 in >=80% of u-bins in [0,2) at x3,x4.
predictions_frozen_before_training.D2: nocell vs baseline: PSNR loss shrinks with scale (x2 > x3 > x4 > x6) and is <=0.03 dB at x4 and x6.
